nearest_mapped_water_km.method: Minimum planar distance to mapped water feature geometry.

road_density_within_1km.method: Sum of mapped road-line lengths clipped to a 1 km radius circle, divided by circle area.

building_footprint_coverage_within_1km.method: Union area of mapped building footprints clipped to a 1 km radius circle divided by circle area.

nearest_airport_km.method: Planar distance to the centroid of the nearest mapped aerodrome with an IATA code (scheduled-service airport).

nearest_metro_station_km.method: Planar distance to the nearest mapped operational metro station (OSM station=subway).

nearest_rail_station_km.method: Planar distance to the nearest mapped railway station or halt, excluding metro.

nearest_highway_km.method: Planar distance to the nearest mapped motorway or trunk road (typically national/state highways).

locations.caveat: These are indicative counts and distances to OpenStreetMap-mapped features around reference points, not parcel-level assessments. Missing mapped features do not imply real-world absence.
